CustomField.description: Auto-computed approval tier label based on Discount: 20-30% = Tier 1 (Sales Manager), 30-50% = Tier 2 (Finance Director), 50%+ = Tier 3 (VP Sales). Used in approval emails so the recipient sees which deal-desk tier this quote escalated to.
CustomField.formula: IF(Discount > 0.50, "Tier 3 - VP Sales Approval", IF(Discount > 0.30, "Tier 2 - Finance Director Approval", IF(Discount > 0.20, "Tier 1 - Sales Manager Approval", "Auto-Approved (under 20%)")))
CustomField.label: Approval Tier Label
